description: This source file contains SQL DDL statements, functions, and queries related to the Orleans framework's ADO.NET persistence layer for an Oracle database. It defines table structure, indexes, and stored procedures for storing, updating, and retrieving grain state data with considerations for scalability and performance.

methods.name: WriteToStorage
methods.description: Function to insert or update grain state data in the Oracle storage table, handling concurrency and versioning.

methods.name: ClearStorage
methods.description: Function to logically delete or nullify grain state payloads in the Oracle storage table, updating the version.
